displayQuote: Do not block the way of inquiry

meta.title: Who really said "Do not block the way of inquiry"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: This is Peirce’s rule against obstructing inquiry, conventionally cited as Collected Papers 1.135. The exact sentence is securely documented.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The maxim follows a rule that genuine learning requires a desire to learn rather than satisfaction with existing beliefs. The manuscript or lecture occasion and the later publication are separate dates; no first-publication claim is made for an earlier lecture year.
